actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.name: action

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: TAVIS is a benchmark for egocentric active-vision imitation learning on humanoid torsos with eight simulated manipulation tasks across the Fourier GR1T2 and Pollen Reachy 2 robots
The same tasks run on both humanoid torsos with a canonical 19-D action layout
make_env.py is described as the single environment-construction entry point
make_tavis_env composes an embodiment, a task and an optional scene, and defaults to 1 environment, cameras enabled, a 20 Hz robot control rate and 100 s episodes
make_tavis_env builds an IsaacLabArenaEnvironment named tavis_env
make_tavis_env builds and registers the environment with ArenaEnvBuilder.build_registered
make_tavis_env creates the environment with gym.make(name, cfg=cfg).unwrapped and resets it once
make_tavis_env wraps the environment in CanonicalFrameWrapper before returning it
CanonicalFrameWrapper extends gymnasium.Wrapper so downstream wrappers see a Gymnasium Env
CanonicalFrameWrapper.step adds the embodiment's canonical-frame offset to the left and right arm IK position targets before stepping the wrapped environment
GR1T2Embodiment is the GR1T2 robot embodiment with Robotiq 2F-85 grippers and NullspaceIK control
The GR1T2 action space is 19-D: left and right arm IK (7 each), head roll (1), head pitch and yaw (2) and one gripper command per hand (1 each)
GR1T2Embodiment.modify_env_cfg sets the simulation timestep to 1/60 s
Reachy2Embodiment is the Reachy 2 robot embodiment with NullspaceIK control
Simulation, data collection and evaluation need an NVIDIA GPU with ray-tracing support, and RTX is required at rendering time
The installer bootstraps the pinned stack into a conda environment on Python 3.11
isaacsim, isaaclab and isaaclab-arena must be installed separately and are not on PyPI
Plain pip install -e . will not install correctly; pyproject.toml instructs uv pip install -e .

determinism.notes: the fake seeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 and its kinematic update is deterministic; upstream reset(seed) controls Isaac Lab's generators, and the fake was not compared with the upstream environment because that stack was not run

gaps: kinematic F0 stand-in: no Isaac Sim physics, contacts, IK, actuator, sensor, noise or rendering model; the fake adds a fixed fraction of each action to one coordinate per joint per tick

the real action space is the batched Box of Isaac Lab's action manager, 19 wide for the GR1T2 embodiment (7 + 7 arm IK, 1 head roll, 2 head pitch/yaw and 2 grippers), transformed by CanonicalFrameWrapper; num_envs defaults to 1 but can be larger, while the MHS bridge drives one environment and the fake uses a single 19-element action Box and no canonical-frame conversion

the real observation is the environment's Dict of observation groups, including the head-mounted camera images (image_or_zeros handles disabled cameras); the fake publishes one policy group of 19 numbers and no image, so the real arrays are larger

timestep_ms is the default control period of 50 ms (robot_ctrl_rate 20 Hz, make_env.py:20); the fake advances one integer tick per step and models no simulated time, while the upstream decimation is computed from the simulator's 60 Hz step and robot_ctrl_rate can change both
episode_length_s defaults to 100 s and is passed to the task (make_env.py:21 and :48); the fake has no episode limit and no task success or reward model

there is no fixed env_id to gym.make: make_tavis_env registers the composed environment as tavis_env at build time, so only the package fake backend is provided and the upstream simulator path is not configured

the upstream stack (Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, IsaacLab-Arena, Python 3.11 per README.md:59 and an NVIDIA RTX GPU per README.md:47-49) requires USD assets downloaded from Hugging Face and was never started here
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state/set_state
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and clock lockstep

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
